_read_me: Spoilers. The GM console loads this for gm and admin sign-ins only. Edit the lines freely; the timed cues take their times from Settings (hint_1, hint_2, hint_3, forced_merge). A cue with no time_setting has no clock against it and is there to send whenever it is needed. Wording follows The Last Guest Guide (GM / Facilitator Flow Deck), which asks for the smallest nudge that moves players forward — never name Natalie before they have connected the evidence.

cues.line: Hint 1 — clock: "Is there anything in the photo that gives you a second time?"
Hint 2 — window: "If the reaction takes 10 to 20 minutes, what time did Kai eat?"

Forced merge — both halves in the same room. Ask A what they found about the food, the allergy and the motive; ask B what the corrected times say. Put the allergy card, the 10:30 collapse, the corrected timeline and the dessert evidence side by side.
Hint 3 — opportunity: "Who was alone with the desserts at a time inside that window?"
Optional — motive: "Why would tonight matter more than tomorrow morning?"
Optional — method: "Why are there two desserts, and why is one labelled NUT FREE?"

reset: Return Kai to the starting position.
Reset both dessert plates: the nut dessert at Kai's seat, the NUT FREE one back where it starts.
Replace the receipt, the allergy card, the notebook, the draft will, the solicitor letter and the empty EpiPen case.
Re-place the suspect cards and the suspect statements.
Reset the camera stills and the timeline materials.
Set the lock box back to 0000 — never leave it on 1012, it gives the answer away.
Both desk devices back to the phone's home screen — the file's own reset, top-left of its lock screen.
Check the off-limits areas are still marked and every prop players can reach is safe.
Split the next group at the door and read them their half.
